diagnostic_evidence.quote: Then we apply the Gating Lemma \ref{Gatinglemma} to have a $\mathcal{FFN}(3)$ to subtract off the constant $M$ only from columns $D+1$ to $2D$.

issues.failure_explanation: The Gating Lemma as stated only either keeps a token unchanged or zeros out its data rows; it does not provide a feed-forward network that subtracts a constant from a token. The proofs of the arithmetic lemmas invoke it to subtract constants (e.g., DM in lemsumD, M in lemadd, lemcmulti, lemsq, lempp, lemrpower, lemdiv). This is an invalid application of the lemma, so the arithmetic constructions are not established as written.

failure_location.quote: Then we apply the Gating Lemma \ref{Gatinglemma} to have a $\mathcal{FFN}(3)$ to subtract off the constant $DM$ in the $D+1$-th column.

issues.least_adequate_overall_repair: Provide a new local lemma or construction showing that a two-layer feed-forward network can subtract a prescribed constant from specified tokens (using the constant row and interaction terms for gating), then replace the misapplications of the Gating Lemma with this construction.
issues.overall_effect: All basic arithmetic operation lemmas and their downstream approximation and generalization theorems rely on this step. Without a valid constant-subtraction FFN, the constructed transformers do not implement the claimed operations, so the main approximation and generalization results are unsupported.
issues.title: Gating Lemma cannot subtract constants
issues.why_classification: The defect is pervasive and blocks the main proof, but it can be repaired by a contained new FFN construction without changing the rates, architecture, or overall proof strategy. Hence more than minor but not serious.

diagnostic_evidence.quote: In the exact manifold case when $q=0$, Theorem \ref{thmGeneralization} gives rise to the min-max regression error

issues.failure_explanation: The definition of the tubular region uses the strict inequality \|u\|_2 < q\tau_{\mathcal{M}}(v). For q=0 this becomes \|u\|_2 < 0, which is impossible. Thus \mathcal{M}(0) is empty, not the exact manifold \mathcal{M}. The prose claim that q=0 recovers the exact manifold regression model is therefore false under the paper's own definition.

failure_location.quote: When $q=0$, one recovers the exact manifold regression model where functions are supported exactly on a low-dimensional manifold.

issues.least_adequate_overall_repair: Change the strict inequality to \|u\|_2 \le q\tau_{\mathcal{M}}(v), or explicitly define \mathcal{M}(0)=\mathcal{M}.
issues.overall_effect: The advertised boundary case q=0 is excluded by the definition, so the paper's claim about recovering the exact manifold setting is not supported.
issues.title: q=0 tubular region is empty, contradicting exact manifold claim
issues.why_classification: A one-line change to the definition (or a separate definition for q=0) repairs the inconsistency and preserves all substantive claims.

diagnostic_evidence.quote: {\rm B}(H) = {\rm FFN}({\rm MHA}(H) + H) + {\rm MHA}(H) + H.

issues.failure_explanation: The transformer block is defined as B(H)=FFN(MHA(H)+H)+MHA(H)+H. If the FFN is the identity map, then B(H)=2(MHA(H)+H). In the final step of Proposition repetatildei, the attention head computes \tilde\eta_i(x) and adds it to the target column, so H1=MHA(H)+H already contains \tilde\eta_i(x). Setting FFN to identity doubles this value to 2\tilde\eta_i(x), not \tilde\eta_i(x). To pass the attention output through unchanged, the FFN must be the zero map (or otherwise cancel the residual addition).

failure_location.quote: For the feed-forward layer of $B_8$, we take the weight matrix equals to identity and bias equals to zero, so that it implements the identity operation.

issues.least_adequate_overall_repair: Set the feed-forward weight matrix to zero and bias to zero in the final block so that B(H)=MHA(H)+H, preserving the computed \tilde\eta_i(x).
issues.overall_effect: Proposition repetatildei constructs 2\tilde\eta_i instead of \tilde\eta_i, invalidating the proposition and all downstream results that use it.
issues.title: Identity FFN doubles the ReLU output in Proposition repetatildei
issues.why_classification: The error is a one-line correction (identity to zero) that preserves the intended construction and all subsequent results.
